requirements.text: Students must be able to manage their borrowing and study needs online
System must automate fine tracking for overdue items
Students must be able to book study rooms online, specifying date, time, and capacity
System must allow librarians to add, update, and retire items from the catalogue
System must generate reports on usage, including popular items and loan volumes
System must integrate with existing student record system for verifying enrolment
System must be user-friendly and accessible for all students
System must provide real-time availability of books and materials in the library catalogue
Students must be able to view their current loans, including due dates and outstanding fines
System must allow librarians to manage student accounts and place holds on accounts with outstanding fines
System must ensure compliance with GDPR when processing and storing student data
System must have robust search functionality for librarians to quickly find items
System must have a solid plan for migrating data from the legacy system without loss
System must be capable of sending automated reminders via email for due dates and fines
System must be designed considering budget constraints for development and maintenance
